text:
maya: Heads-up: I wired up the cross-repo chain for the billing SDK change. Need quick triage on PRs so we can merge before EOD. PRs: https://github.com/redwoodinc/api/pull/5421, https://github.com/redwoodinc/sdk/pull/888, https://github.com/redwoodinc/console/pull/231. @alex can you take api? @tariq can you eyeball console?

alex: on it. i'll run compat tests locally, but ci/runtime-e2e has been flaky. will report back in 20.

tariq: i can review console in ~30m. any breaking contract changes or just additive?

maya: Mostly additive keys in response (billing.plan -> billing.plan_name). sdk needs mapping; api adds a fallback header X-Billing-Compat for older clients. No schema rename.

samir: SDK PR looks fine, left 2 tiny comments re: null handling. once api is green i'll approve.

alex: ran api unit + integ, failing auth middleware for service-to-service token in staging. stacktrace attached:
```
Error: missing audience
    at auth.verifyToken (/src/middleware/auth.js:89)
```
Probably due to local env var JWT_AUD not set. CI passes though.

jen: if CI passes we can merge api, but need console canary to use new sdk mapping. recommend canary on dedicated for 1 hour. @tariq can you set canary flag in helm chart?

tariq: yep. helm diff shows only values change. command i'll run:
```
helm upgrade console-canary ./charts/console --set image.tag=canary-sdkmapping -n prod-canary
```
Will monitor logs.

maya: Sweet. If api goes green, i'll merge api + sdk then ping console to flip mapping flag. plan: merge window 15:30 UTC. Any blockers?

alex: api CI just green. i pushed a small hotfix to auth to skip audience check for service tokens (see commit abc123). merging now.

samir: :thumbsup: merged sdk after resolving null comment. also bumped changelog.

tariq: canary deployed, logs look OK. errors 0 -> stable for first 10 minutes. i'll promote after 45m if stable.

maya: Thanks all. tagging release note for ops. I'll run a post-merge smoke: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer svc-token' https://api.redwood.dev/billing/xyz and check plan_name present. Ping if anything odd.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: api merged by alex (PR #5421). sdk merged by samir (PR #888). console canary deployed by tariq.
